page.lede: Weischenfeldt and colleagues mapped RNA-seq of NMD-deficient mouse liver and macrophages with RAINMAN, a pipeline that is gone. We rebuilt it from the paper and reran it from the reads. Of {attempted} results we tried, {exact} came back exactly, {agrees} agree, {partly} partly agree and {differs} differ.
page.items_caption: Every figure, table and number of the paper, with our value and why it differs.
